title: HireAI Contract (a Task's frozen acceptance terms)
description: The Contract a Task freezes at submit (ADR 0009): one Template version plus the values it sets for that Template's parameters. A receipt's contract.sha256 is the SHA-256 (hex) of this document's RFC 8785 form. Prose: docs/details/receipts.md#the-contract-a-receipt-names.

additionalProperties.description: max/min parameters are numbers, enum parameters one string (a JSON schema parameter is its schema as a string), subset parameters an array of strings, flag parameters a boolean.
